message.reasoning_content: We need to determine appropriate crime label(s) based on facts. The facts: Company (XX县XX有限公司) and its former director/manager Wang Moujia (王某甲) gave cash to a government official (county head Wang Mou) to obtain favorable treatment (keeping the company operating, falsifying high furnace capacity, etc.). This is bribery (行贿) by the company and its legal representative (unit bribery) and also possibly using influence to receive bribes (利用影响力受贿) but the official is the recipient; the company is the briber. The label should be "单位行贿". The correction lessons: There's a rule about "单位行贿;利用影响力受贿" vs "受贿;行贿;单位行贿". The correct label for a company giving bribes to a state official is "单位行贿". If also the official used influence to accept bribe? Actually the official is a state staff receiving bribe, which is "受贿". But the question asks to label the crime(s) for the defendant(s). The defendant includes both the company and Wang Moujia. The company is a legal person, so "单位行贿". Also possibly "利用影响力受贿" applies to the official, not the defendant. So we only label "单位行贿". The example earlier: "单位行贿" used for a case where a company gave bribes. So answer: [罪名]单位行贿<eoa>
